# Nonprofit SEO Playbook Skill for Muse

Built for charities, nonprofits, NGOs, foundations, and membership organisations, it works from one key insight: nonprofits have three audiences with almost nothing in common — donors, service users, and funders — and most charity sites are built for donors while the largest search audience is the people in urgent need of help. It maps the pages that matter (help and service pages, condition explainers, ruthlessly optimised donation pages, impact and outcomes pages, local service pages, published sector research, transparency pages), then covers trust and credibility for YMYL territory (registration numbers, named qualified authors, professional review, indexable accounts and impact reports), accessibility and low-end-device performance as non-negotiables, and how charities' structural advantages — institutional authority, unique service data, and the often under-spent Google ad grant — interact with SEO and AI answer engines. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: this is a strategy and planning playbook, not a done-for-you SEO service or keyword-research tool; it ships with a setup section for Keupera's own MCP tools, which is optional — the playbook works as a standalone strategy guide; charity-grant and registration details are written with a US/UK framing and may need local adaptation. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. skills.sh Trust Hub: Pass.
